# Adriel Alfeus Hutabarat

> Software Engineer with expertise in Go, TypeScript, and Python, specializing in high-performance backend systems, spatial data infrastructure, and reactive web applications. Based in Bekasi, Indonesia.

Adriel Alfeus Hutabarat is a Software Engineer with a Bachelor of Computer Science from Sebelas Maret University (UNS). Passionate about full-stack engineering, distributed systems, high-throughput APIs, and geospatial data processing.

## Career Experience

### Backend Engineer — PT Cakra Jala Teknologi (Jan 2026 - Present)
- Architected an offline-first POS platform in Go, bridging cloud PostgreSQL and local SQLite via CGo and Protobuf to guarantee zero checkout downtime.
- Engineered high-concurrency transaction workflows, dynamic pricing, and financial audits integrated with Epson LX-310 hardware printers.
- Built a full-stack Employee Portal and Logbook using TypeScript and PostgreSQL with role-based access control (RBAC).

### Software Engineer — Idea Comindo (Jun 2025 - Feb 2026)
- Built a full-stack geospatial platform with PostGIS, NestJS GraphQL, Redis, and Dataloader.
- Engineered Python scraping pipelines automating collection of 20GB+ demographic datasets across dozens of countries.
- Integrated AI-driven natural language querying over geospatial datasets using OpenAI and Gemini models.

### Backend Engineer — PT Datasintesa Teknologi Nusantara (Jun 2024 - Jun 2025)
- Developed and maintained BTS telecommunication monitoring systems tracking 5,800+ sites across multiple consortiums.
- Managed asynchronous data pipelines, scheduled extraction jobs, BullMQ job queues, and Elastic APM monitoring.

### Freelance Software Engineer (2024 - 2025)
- **Itemgame**: Scalable digital commerce platform using Go, Docker, Cloudflare CDN, and NATS message broker for peak traffic.
- **Pilates Reform**: Booking and membership platform with Midtrans payment gateway and automated booking notifications.
- **Wijaya Door**: Interactive company profile with custom pricing calculators and localized customer inquiry forms.
